title: HW↔SEC-001: Secure-Element Placement + Debug-Port Lockdown
description: Security provides secure-element selection requirements, the debug-port lockdown policy, physical-hardening/tamper requirements, and the root-of-trust specification; Hardware returns physical placement of the secure element/root-of-trust device, debug-port lockdown implementation, and board tamper-resistance measures with conformance evidence. Grounded in SECURITY_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.3. Two of the six mandatory security-baseline controls live here (hardware root of trust; debug-port lockdown).

hardware_security_implementation.description: HW→SEC: placement + lockdown implementation + conformance evidence.

secure_element_placement.description: Physical placement of the secure element / root-of-trust device on the board.

debug_port_locked.description: Debug port disabled/locked for production (must be true to pass).

conformance_evidence.description: Evidence (test report, photo, scan) of implementation to spec.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Hardware root of trust and debug-port lockdown are part of the mandatory security baseline; any weakening is a Tier-1 security-baseline change behind HG-01 (SEC release veto). ESC-SEC: agents may only propose; SEC owns binding decisions.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (security-requirement handoff at planning; secure-element and debug-lockdown review; pre-production hardening sign-off)
confirm_conditions: security_hardware_requirements carries a debug_port_lockdown_policy and a root_of_trust_spec
secure_element_placement and root_of_trust_device documented with conformance_evidence
tamper-resistance measures implemented to the SEC requirement
reject_conditions: debug_port_locked = false on a production build (security-baseline violation → ESC-SEC, HG-01)
secure element / root-of-trust placement absent or unverified
any baseline weakening proposed without an ADR + SEC sign-off (never silently deviate)
counter_conditions: secure-element part availability constrained — request a SEC-approved equivalent before board freeze
tamper measure conflicts with enclosure/cost — request a SEC risk-acceptance decision (SIRC), not a unilateral trade
